breaking_news.headline: New rule aims to close loophole on chip exports
breaking_news.summary: The Commerce Department released a new rule designed to make it harder for China to gain access to America's most powerful computer chips using third-country data centers.

breaking_news.headline: She went to college to become a social worker. Now she's joined the skilled trades
breaking_news.summary: While the rise of AI continues to fuel the debate over whether college is worth the cost, apprenticeships in the skilled trades are having a moment, drawing in people of all backgrounds including college graduates.

breaking_news.headline: Can Google win the AI race without killing its cash cow?
breaking_news.summary: In late October, Google had the worst stock day in its history as a public company. The Planet Money newsletter asks: has Google been caught in "the innovator's dilemma"?

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia board says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
breaking_news.summary: The former Nvidia CEO said he would be "honored" to return if the board allowed. But the board says it has no intention of reinstating him.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia tries to get back to business
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia quarterly earnings are in. But the biggest question isn't about past business performance it's about the company's future leadership.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia needs more than a new CEO. An expert offers a way forward
breaking_news.summary: Nvidia needs a new CEO. Keeping its engineers is another story.

breaking_news.headline: Nvidia hold first earnings call since former CEO's departure
breaking_news.summary: Chip giant Nvidia held its first earnings call since the departure of former CEO Jensen Huang, as interim CEO Colette Kress takes over.

breaking_news.headline: Karl Kani dressed hip-hop royalty for decades. Now he's telling his own story
breaking_news.summary: On NPR's Morning Edition, fashion designer Karl Kani talks about his new memoir, dressing some of hip-hop's biggest stars and why skinny jeans aren't for everyone.

breaking_news.headline: Ghana's new $60m presidential jet sparks public outrage
breaking_news.summary: The purchase has sparked outrage over its cost as many Ghanaians struggle with rising cost of living.

breaking_news.headline: Parents jailed for torture and death of four-year-old girl found along French motorway in 1987
breaking_news.summary: Inass Touloub's body was found along the A10 road in 1987, bearing marks of abuse, and was not identified until 2018.

breaking_news.headline: Grand Theft Auto 6 is a masterpiece, say critics
breaking_news.summary: Critics have their say as to whether GTA 6, the most anticipated video game of all time, lives up to the hype.

breaking_news.headline: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
breaking_news.summary: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.

breaking_news.headline: William and Kate reflect on 'enduring' UK-India ties with Modi
breaking_news.summary: The meeting in New Delhi was a late addition to the royal couple's India visit, which has also included their appearance at the annual Earthshot Prize

breaking_news.headline: Trump shakes hands with Putin and Xi ahead of historic talks in China
breaking_news.summary: The three leaders will meet together for the first time on Thursday during a closely-watched summit.

breaking_news.headline: 'The drones don't fly here' - BBC reports from Ukraine's new front line
breaking_news.summary: Ukrainian forces are fighting Russian troops in an old Soviet tunnel in the Kharkiv region.

breaking_news.headline: Inside the old gas pipeline where Ukraine is fighting an underground war with Russia
breaking_news.summary: Watch: The BBC's Jonathan Beale joins Ukrainian forces taking the battle below ground and out of sight of Russian drones.

breaking_news.headline: Government backs welfare shake-up to prevent 'lost generation'
breaking_news.summary: Ex-minister Alan Milburn has set out plans to divert spending from benefits towards job support.

breaking_news.headline: Jeff Bezos says he was 'heavily involved' in casting Robert Pattinson as new Bond
breaking_news.summary: The Amazon chairman says he was originally "biased against" Pattinson "because he's already so famous".

breaking_news.headline: Europe plans to catch the next computer chip wave
breaking_news.summary: Europe hopes to be a leader in a new generation of computer chips which use light to process data.

breaking_news.headline: How important are Nvidia and Jensen Huang to the US economy?
breaking_news.summary: The former Nvidia chief executive has been at the centre of the artificial intelligence boom.
